Alibaba Group Holding Limited 阿里巴巴集團控股有限公司 (Incorporated in the Cayman Islands with limited liability) (Stock Code: 9988 (HKD Counter) and 89988 (RMB Counter)) PROPOSED SPIN-OFF AND SEPARATE LISTING OF T-HEAD ON THE MAIN BOARD OF THE STOCK EXCHANGE OF HONG KONG LIMITED Alibaba Group Holding Limited (“ Alibaba ”, “ Alibaba Group ” or the “ Company ”) announced that it has submitted a proposal in relation to the proposed spin-off and separate listing of T-Head (Shanghai) Technology Co., Ltd.* (平頭哥(上海)技術股份有限公司) (“ T-Head ”), a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company (the “ Proposed Spin-off ”) to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange pursuant to PN15 of the Listing Rules. The Company is pleased to announce that the Hong Kong Stock Exchange has confirmed that the Company may proceed with the Proposed Spin-off, and therefore, on September 11, 2026, T-Head, on a confidential basis, submitted a listing application form (Form A1) to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange to apply for the listing of, and permission to deal in, the T-Head H Shares on the Main Board of the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. It is currently proposed that the Proposed Spin-off will be effected by way of the Global Offering of T-Head’s H Shares, comprising (i) a Hong Kong public offering of T-Head’s H Shares for subscription by the public in Hong Kong; and (ii) a placing of T-Head’s H Shares to institutional and professional investors. As at the date of this announcement, T-Head is a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company and is a leading provider of full-stack data center chips which enable system-level compute solutions in China. Following completion of the Proposed Spin-off, it is expected that T-Head will remain as a subsidiary of the Company. 1 Details in respect of the Proposed Spin-off, including the size and structure of the Global Offering and the extent of the decrease in the Company’s shareholding percentage in T-Head, have not yet been finalized.
